NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1704 South Racine Avenue
From RT-4 to RM-4.5

The Property
The subject property is located in an RT-4 zoning district in an area that includes RT-4, RM4.5, and multi-

unit residential buildings, many of them three to four stories in height. The property also is located in a
Transit Served Location and is approximately 800.0’ from the Blue Island (Route 60) CTA bus corridor
stop.

The property is improved with a one-and-a-half story two unit residential building. There is no parking.
The building is in a dilapidated state and not suitable for habitation.

The Project
Ryan Martinez (the “Applicant’”) seeks to construct a new three story building (37’-9” zoning height) with

four residential units and three surface parking spaces.

To allow the proposed project the Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RT-4, Residential Two-
Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to an RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

The Applicant also seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) and including: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-
B to reduce the required front yard setback per section 17-17-0309 to zero to allow a front porch and 2) an
optional variation under sections 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-1101-A to increase parking from zero spaces
pursuant to section 17-10-0102-B to three spaces.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,125 square feet

FAR.: 13

Total Building Floor Area: 3,948 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 4

MLA Density: 781.3 square feet

Height: 377-9”

Automobile Parking: 3

Rear Yard Open Space: 305 square feet

Setbacks: Front (East/Racine Avenue): —_zero*
Side (North): 37-1 4”
Side (South): 3°-6”
Rear (West/alley): 45°-8”

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks all available and optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
